study: Shealy et al. 2025, DNA methylation-based age prediction and sex-specific epigenetic aging in a lizard with female-biased longevity
reuse: NCBI GEO states it places no restrictions on use or distribution; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/info/disclaimer.html

protocol.scaffold_rule: 14 longest AnoSag2.1 scaffolds by reference length
protocol.sample_rule: All 37 GEO matrix sample columns with unique age-in-months metadata; no sex restriction
protocol.canonical_cpg_coordinate: plus-strand cytosine coordinate, or minus-strand cytosine coordinate minus one; 1-based
protocol.strand_collapse: Unweighted arithmetic mean of available strand-specific methylation percentages per sample
protocol.age_test: Two-sided Spearman rho between age in months and percent methylation, pairwise nonmissing, scipy 1.17.0 asymptotic t p-value; constant rows p=1
protocol.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over every tested collapsed CpG dyad on the 14 scaffolds; q<0.05
protocol.extreme_definition: Per-sample methylation percentage strictly below 10 or strictly above 90
protocol.density_definition: Unique extreme age-associated CpG dyads per Mb of each scaffold; arithmetic mean of all 14 scaffold densities
protocol.distribution_null: Unique extreme-site counts proportional to full reference scaffold base lengths

limits: GEO matrix is unfiltered and stranded; the source transformation is not identical to Dryad's coverage-filtered, de-stranded matrix. Original Verified avian study and answers are excluded.
